reporting_basis: Project-reported physical inventory. Under project policy, CENT is minted only after the corresponding physical pennies have been received.
limitations: The physical count is reported by the project and has not yet been independently attested.
On-chain mint and burn records verify token issuance and supply changes; they do not independently prove physical custody.
Holding CENT does not create a guaranteed redemption right or a legal claim on any specific penny.
The live token supply may change after this snapshot.
